1.consolidated_definition: Se llaman asimismo timones o manceras, por el norte central, a los palos del arado que permiten que el timonero guíe según tiran los bueyes.
1.en_consolidated_definition: These are also referred to as timons or manceras, particularly in the central north, to the poles of the plow that allow the plowman to guide by pulling the oxen.
